skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and contents of urban project management, and the benefits and impacts of urban projects on urban development.
Apply theories and principles of urban project management to explain, analyze, and propose solutions for urban projects in real-world scenarios.
Analyze urban project issues, risks, and management to prepare for group presentations.
Work independently and in groups to solve assigned tasks.
Develop self-learning and research skills to enhance professional expertise.
Identify and propose solutions for issues arising in urban projects, and demonstrate planning, coordination, and team intelligence through group exercises.
